bindingMethod: committed repository records bound by exact SHA-256 at build time, with every relied-on statement re-read from the committed bytes as an anchor before composing
formIdentityNote: The controlling records require a custom participant petition and name no official participant form. Every rendered page is therefore composed from the committed codified-text authority chain; no source binary was acquired, substituted or invented.

committedRecords.role: the controlling decision for the exact legacy pathway: it supersedes the interim guidance treatment and requires a § 42-8-66 custom participant petition gated on written prosecutorial consent
the detailed committed route record projected from the controlling national decision: mechanism, required facts, component list, consent gate, route branches, venue, fee and self-help limits
the adopted LA-IMM-01 filing vehicle, hearing rule and July 1, 2026 implementation rule for the proposed order and post-order instructions

the committed assignment-identity dependency: it preserves the exact legacy obligation key and points that key to CLD-2026-08-28-GA-RFO; its superseded § 42-8-62.1 presentation is not used as substantive authority

identityRefreshHistory.method: Recovered exact historical census blob and compared every bound route object, selected by the receipt family route keys, object-for-object against the current default-generated census. Only whole-file identity changed for these anchors.

finalSnapshotReconciliation.reason: After the final census regeneration, compared the same bound route objects against the preserved historical census before refreshing only whole-file identity. The subsequent reconciliation regenerates dependent state without rewriting this source snapshot.

integrationSnapshotReconciliation.reason: Final worker integrations changed generated fulfillment bookkeeping fingerprints. After settling those inputs at one unchanged Captain commit, regenerate the census and verify every bound historical route object before refreshing only this whole-file reference. Packet bytes and approval verdicts are unchanged.

supersededBy.why: the source moved again: the annotation was written against f6fc081419ea and this build measured eeabd8b97786. Nobody has compared anchors across that second move and this build cannot; a live note would assert that comparison, so the note is kept as history and the pin reads as moved until a measured re-pin

whatThisReceiptDoesNotEstablish: that any output is approved for participant delivery
that any record is eligible for the relief this family composes for
that verified written prosecutorial consent, joinder or signed consent endorsement exists for any participant
that the participant satisfies statutory eligibility or the interests-of-justice showing
that no qualifying order has already been granted
that any route, payment, generation or fulfillment gate is open
